parent_stencil_limit_amendment.limit_state_eligibility: an approaching inner-margin breach has a policy-bounded strictly improving shift but no legal strictly improving shift solely because the child is at the exact parent-stencil placement limit, while every selected face remains outside relaxation

limitations: All numerical thresholds, geometry, aperture, measurement cadence, movement caps, and v11 trusted-improvement rules are inherited from the immutable v11 policy chain.
No comparison metric from the invalid v11 candidate was inspected or used to alter a threshold.
Every movement candidate is constrained by exact live parent-stencil placement bounds before projection or transaction.

The parent-stencil-limited state performs no mutation and is trusted only while every selected face remains outside relaxation and a policy-bounded strictly improving shift exists but the corresponding legal shift does not.
Any current relaxation-zone entry, malformed bounds, ambiguity, topology change, nonfinite evidence, or attempted out-of-bounds transaction remains fail-closed.
A pass remains a bounded same-equation fixed-aperture comparison and does not enable public moving_nest selection or broaden supported physics/backend combinations.
